title: Human choose-and-apply gate for rewrite options
description:
## Intent

Human chooses; nothing applies until then.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Human apply gate
  As the Pilobolus editor
  I want to pick among ranked options
  So published copy changes only when I apply

  Scenario: No auto-apply
    Given rewrite decisions and generated options for one article
    When I run limatus compare on those option texts
    Then I obtain a ranking of all options
    And the published article is unchanged
    And apply happens only after I record a chosen option id
```
